name: Isabella Rodriguez
bio:
Isabella's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood in Bogota, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with her father. After graduating with a degree in electrical engineering from the Universidad Nacional de Colombia, she initially worked on power grid infrastructure, but her heart remained with racing. A chance encounter with a visiting team during a local karting event opened the door to her motorsport career.

Isabella thrives on the challenges of optimizing electrical systems for peak performance and reliability. She believes in a hands-on approach, working closely with mechanics and drivers to understand their needs and translate them into tangible improvements. Her ability to adapt to changing circumstances and find innovative solutions has earned her a reputation as a highly effective electronics engineer.

What sets Isabella apart is her meticulous attention to detail combined with her calm and collected demeanor under pressure. She is unflappable in the face of setbacks, inspiring confidence in her colleagues and fostering a collaborative team environment.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Isabella has a warm smile and a focused gaze that reflects her dedication to her work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with circuit diagrams and handwritten notes.
Has a habit of humming quietly when deeply focused on a problem.
Insists on calibrating all testing equipment herself before any major session.
